fact: In September 2026 a total of 17,373 Somali pastoralists received US$3.43 million in drought Takaful payouts under HoA DRIVE after satellite monitoring confirmed vegetation conditions had reached payout thresholds in covered areas of Hiiraan, Galguduud, Lower Shabelle, Bay and Middle Shabelle.
title: Drought Takaful insurance delivers US$3.43 million to 17,373 Somali pastoralists
